title: 2025 HMMT February Guts Problem 6
statement: Let \(\triangle ABC\) be an equilateral triangle. Point \(D\) lies on segment \(\overline{BC}\) such that \(BD = 1\) and \(DC = 4\) . Points \(E\) and \(F\) lie on rays \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) , respectively, such that \(D\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{EF}\) . Compute \(EF\) .

solutions.text:
Let \(C^{\prime}\) be the reflection of \(C\) over \(D\) . Then, \(\overline{{E C}}\parallel \overline{{C^{\prime}F}}\) since \(E C F C^{\prime}\) is a parallelogram. Thus, \(B F C^{\prime}\) is an equilateral triangle, so \(B F = B C^{\prime} = 3\) and \(\angle F B D = 120^{\circ}\) . By Law of Cosines, we get \(D F = \sqrt{3^{2} + 3\cdot1 + 1^{2}} = \sqrt{13}\) and \(E F = \boxed {2\sqrt {13}}\) .
